title: DIVINE LOVE

blocks.text: “This letter is very important, it concerns the subject of divine love which is not often seen in our age! Also subjects concerning providence, faith, predestination! The Lord Jesus told me He was appearing to the Bride as the new morning and evening breeze! His presence dominating her from head to toe covering her in glory as the Bright and Morning Star reflects His light!” – “In Hosea 6:2-3, it speaks of a reviving and time periods. This can be prophetic not only to the Jews, but to the Gentiles! Since the early 1900’s we entered a remarkable outpouring! First with the tongues at the turn of the century, then in 1947 came the gifts, and now we are preparing for translative faith and super manifestations of God’s spirit!” – Joel 2:23, “is speaking of these two last moves we have mentioned! So you see where we are now!” Zech. 10:1, “reveals restora- tion, speaking of the latter rain, revealing the Lord shall make bright clouds and give showers of rain! The bright clouds of His glory have been seen and photographed along with many attributes of His spirit!” – “Thus saith the Lord, the Sun of righteousness is rising with healing in His guiding wings!” – “This outpouring will be marked by His Word, divine love and true anointing; the elect will never feel such joy! You can count on it, it’s appearing!”

“And divine love has been missing from many members of the elect body, but through united prayer it will come in combination with real translative faith! Evidently the true body will be persecuted just before the translation, for in the past this always brought out divine love and true faith! Jesus will allow it again to purge and form His elect body!” – In I John 3:11, “reveals the Church must return to what was given in the beginning and involved spiritual love!"” – In I Cor. 13:1-3 Paul gives us wisdom, “Though a man could move mountains and give his body to be burned, and he did not have divine love, it was all just a loud noise! Let’s strive for this fruit of the spirit which is important!” (Gal. 5:22) “Divine love, it’s good medicine for the soul and body! It will produce healing and give soundness to your faith and testimony!”

“In Eph. 4:2, Paul says, forbearing one another in love to keep the unity of the spirit in the bond of peace!” Verse 3-5, “One Lord, one faith, one baptism!” Verse 8 reveals, “He conquered all and gave powerful gifts to men! For the perfecting of the saints and the edifying of the body,” (Verse 12). – Verse 13, “speaks in the unity of faith and the fullness of Christ! In this Headstone revival of divine love His children will not be tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine (verse 14). And they will abide under the shadow of the Almighty; and those He sent to me will abide for they will find fulfillment! This is His will and not my words!” Verse 16, “Says the whole body fitly joined together, and that all the parts will be compacted working together in the edifying of itself in love! In verse 15, speaking of the truth and love growing up into Him with all things which is the HEAD!” – “His elect body is formed to the Capstone, the Lord Jesus, and no man will be able to pluck them away or out of His hand! Thus are the words of the living God! Not once do I want to bind the people to me, but by divine providence the Lord Jesus will bind them to Himself. I am just a sign speaking by utterance! Jesus will hold and unify them by faith and they will be rooted and grounded in love!” (Eph. 3:17) Verse 19, “reveals this leads to the fullness of God! There is to arise an incredible people, a group of loyal royal believers and they will be joined literally and spiritually to the great Headstone of God!” – “There are a multitude of Scriptures to bear this out but here are two!” (Mark 12:10 – Zech. 4:7-10) “We are in a great outpouring and He foreknew us!”

“The Lord gave this next paragraph by divine inspiration and I thought it should definitely be reprinted here in this revelation letter! When the Holy Spirit puts the right Scriptures together they blend into a beautiful sweet harmony of divine presence promoting confidence!” – “In fact Paul gives us valuable insight along with many more Bible writers concerning God’s foreknowledge! Wherein we know the Jews rejected the Headstone, but the Bride receives it as her Headship!” – Rom. 9:32-33, “For they “stumbled” at that stumbling stone!” It is written, “behold I lay in Sion a stumbling stone and a ROCK of offence! And whosoever believeth on Him shall “not be ashamed!” – “It’s a wonderful mystery to know God predestinated a seed that He will visit at the end.” – “Yes, the world and lukewarm churches will be offended by the very true elect! But they will have the rock of offence, the divine love stone of the ages hovering with them!” Rom. 9:11, “reveals the purpose of God by election might stand, not of works, but of Him that calleth!” – Eph. 1:4-5, “Who foreknew us and predestinated us before the foundation of the world!” – “In I Peter 2:8-9, reveals the elect would be chosen by the Rock of Offence, and will be called a peculiar and royal people!” – Rom. 11:5, “the Lord always has a remnant according to his election of grace!” – In Rom. 10:15, “How beautiful are them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!” Those who work and help in this ministry and love the Lord Jesus fulfill this Scripture and are foreknown in Rom. 8:29, “He did foreknow and did predestinate!” “It is good to know that God has a plan for each of us and we will fold into His wings of divine providence! He has a place prepared in eternity for each one! Jesus loves you and is very close to you at the moment of this reading!” – “Thank Him!”
In the abundant love and blessings of Jesus,
